itemSnapshots.BC-018: {"status":"TODO","progress":0,"title":"Publish reservation domain events","description":"Publish reservation lifecycle events after commit and process notifications and audit records asynchronously.","scope":"`src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/reservations/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/common/events/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/config/`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/reservations/`","type":"feature","priority":"P2","acceptanceCriteria":["Created, confirmed, checked-in, checked-out, and cancelled reservations publish distinct events","Events are delivered through `@TransactionalEventListener` with `AFTER_COMMIT`","Listeners execute asynchronously on a configured task executor","A listener failure does not roll back or fail the completed reservation operation","Audit output records actor, action, reservation identifier, and timestamp","Integration tests verify event publication timing and listener execution"]}

itemSnapshots.BC-021: {"status":"DONE","progress":100,"title":"Implement stay reviews","description":"Allow the guest who completed a reservation to create one rated review and expose paginated hotel review summaries.","scope":"`src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/reviews/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/reservations/`, `src/main/resources/db/migration/V8__Add_Reviews_Table.sql`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/reviews/`","type":"feature","priority":"P1","acceptanceCriteria":["Only the user who owns a `COMPLETED` reservation can create its review","A reservation can have at most one review","Ratings outside the inclusive range 1-5 are rejected with `400 Bad Request`","`GET /api/v1/hotels/{id}/reviews` returns paginated reviews and the average rating","Review detail returns `404 Not Found` for an unknown review identifier","Unit and integration tests cover authorization, uniqueness, validation, pagination, and average-rating calculation"]}
itemSnapshots.BC-020: {"status":"DONE","progress":100,"title":"Implement reservation payments","description":"Add simulated payment processing, status queries, and refunds for confirmed reservations behind a replaceable gateway boundary.","scope":"`src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/payments/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/reservations/`, `src/main/resources/db/migration/V7__Add_Payments_Table.sql`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/payments/`","type":"feature","priority":"P1","acceptanceCriteria":["A payment can be created only for a reservation in `CONFIRMED` status","A completed payment moves the reservation to `IN_PROGRESS`","A refund can be created only for a `COMPLETED` payment","The payment amount equals the reservation total price","Payment status transitions cover `PENDING`, `COMPLETED`, `FAILED`, and `REFUNDED`","Unit and integration tests cover successful, failed, duplicate, and refund flows"]}
itemSnapshots.BC-017: {"status":"DONE","progress":100,"title":"Implement reservation management","description":"Implement reservation creation, querying, and lifecycle transitions while preventing overlapping bookings and keeping room state consistent.","scope":"`src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/reservations/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/rooms/`, `src/main/resources/db/migration/V6__Add_Reservations_Table.sql`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/reservations/`","type":"feature","priority":"P1","acceptanceCriteria":["Reservation creation rejects overlapping dates for the same room","Check-out date must be after check-in date and invalid ranges return `400 Bad Request`","Total price equals the number of nights multiplied by the room nightly price","Only valid transitions from `PENDING` to `CONFIRMED`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, or `CANCELLED` are accepted","Confirming a reservation marks the room `RESERVED` and cancelling it restores `AVAILABLE`","Reservation listing supports user, status, and date filters with pagination","Unit and integration tests cover every state transition and the complete booking flow"]}

itemSnapshots.BC-008: {"status":"DONE","progress":100,"title":"Add roles and granular authorities","description":"Persist roles and authorities and apply them to API operations so access is controlled by explicit permissions.","scope":"`src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/config/security/`, `src/main/resources/db/migration/V4__Add_Roles_Authorities.sql`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`","type":"feature","priority":"P1","acceptanceCriteria":["`ROLE_GUEST`, `ROLE_STAFF`, and `ROLE_ADMIN` are persisted and loaded into the security context","Authorities include user read/write, hotel management, and reservation creation permissions","A guest can read hotels but cannot create or modify them","Staff can manage reservations and administrators retain access to all declared operations","Flyway seeds are idempotent and the user-to-role relationship is persisted","Authorization tests cover every declared role and protected endpoint combination"]}
itemSnapshots.BC-007: {"status":"DONE","progress":100,"title":"Implement stateless JWT authentication","description":"Add login and registration authentication with signed, expiring JWTs and protect API endpoints through Spring Security.","scope":"`BACKLOG.md`, `.codeconductor/`, `build.gradle.kts`, `.env.example`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/config/security/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/auth/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/users/`, `src/main/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/common/exception/GlobalExceptionHandler.kt`, `src/main/resources/application.yaml`, `src/main/resources/application-test.yaml`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/security/`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/auth/`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/example/`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/hotels/`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/ping/`, `src/test/kotlin/com/lgzarturo/springbootcourse/features/sentry/`, `src/test/resources/application.yaml`, `docs/`","type":"feature","priority":"P1","acceptanceCriteria":["Valid credentials at `POST /api/v1/auth/login` return `200 OK` with a signed JWT","Registration reuses public `POST /api/v1/users`, which creates `GUEST` users","Invalid credentials return `401 Unauthorized`","Protected endpoints return `401 Unauthorized` without a valid token","A valid token with an allowed role reaches the protected endpoint, while an insufficient role returns `403 Forbidden`","Expired or invalidly signed tokens return `401 Unauthorized`","JWT claims include the username, roles, and expiration timestamp","MockMvc integration tests cover public, authenticated, forbidden, and expired-token requests"]}
